mapper.sql: select r.rule_id, r.rule_name, r.material_id, r.rule_pattern, r.current_seq, r.seq_date, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, mm.material_name from food_batch_rule r left join wms_material mm on mm.material_id = r.material_id
mapper.select: where r.material_id = #{materialId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into food_batch_rule (rule_name, material_id, rule_pattern, current_seq, seq_date, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{ruleName}, #{materialId}, #{rulePattern}, 0, null, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
